dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent closed-loop and C-shaped structures are visible along the mid-dorsal and lateral surfaces. These structures feature dark, irregular perimeters (approximately 5-10 pixels in width) that create a sharp gradient transition to lighter, golden-tan interior regions. The geometry of the largest mid-dorsal loops is roughly elliptical with jagged, non-uniform edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity dark pixel clusters are primarily localized within the line-work of the annuli rather than existing as independent solid blobs. There is a low density of isolated, asymmetrical dark clusters, with most core pixel concentrations occurring at the intersections of adjacent ring perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. A secondary configuration of four smaller centroids in the posterior region forms a localized cluster with a roughly trapezoidal geometric relationship.
